procedural_matters: DEN2496 was represented by Emilie Vestero Nielsen.
International Jury was represented by Chris Lindsay.
Cecilie Hojgaard Jenseb crew of DEN 2496 attended the hearing as an observer.
Albeste Klames crew of DEN 3311 gave evidence as a witness for DEN2496 and provided video evidence.
facts: Race 4, about 15 seconds before the starting signal, wind approximately 4 knots
DEN 2496 was on the starting line.
Jury observers penalized DEN 2496 under RRS P1.2 before the start: they pointed the yellow flag, whistled and shouted the number at about 2 RIB lengths.
DEN 2496 established visual contact with the observers.
DEN 2496 did not take any penalty after being penalized.
Just after rounding mark 1, the observers penalized DEN 2496 a second time under RRS P1.2.
DEN 2496 was scored DNE in race 4.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the International Jury. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
Since the penalty was not due to the failure to take into account a race committee signal or a class rule, DEN 2496 is not entitled to redress as provided by RRS P4.
